title: 第13章 他长你一辈可唤叔父第14章 原来早就暗通款曲
lines: 石榴将戴缨带到上房，屋中已掌灯。
陆老夫人歪坐在罗汉榻上，陆婉儿、陆溪儿、谢珍等几个小辈围在跟前说笑。
陆老夫人见了戴缨，招手让她上前。
“行当都安置了？”
“回老夫人的话，都安置好了。”
陆老夫人“恩”
了一声：“你且安心住下，府里的下人若是不听使唤，直言道出，千万别不声不响。”
那日在青山寺，这丫头一番言辞恳切，说她出身商贾，怕阻谢家小郎前程，又说甘愿解除婚契。
她是不信的，在陆老夫人心里，必是谢家想同自家结亲，为了娶婉儿那丫头，让戴缨不得不自行退亲。
变相来说，他们家毁了她的一门好姻缘，这让陆老夫人不免起了怜意。
陆婉儿是她身边长大的，是自家人，也就只能委屈戴缨了。
“劳老夫人挂心，缨娘不是那不响的人，就怕日后老夫人嫌缨娘话太密。”
戴缨趣说道。
陆老夫人乐呵笑出声：“那可好，我正嫌屋中太静，你常常过来陪我说话。”
戴缨哪有不应的，她日后的倚仗就是这位，只要她不嫌烦，她巴不得一整日候在她跟前。
正说着，陆婉儿凑了来，伏到老夫人另一侧：“祖母怎么不让婉儿常来？戴姐姐才来一日，您这心就偏了。”
陆老夫人气打了她一下，说道：“你好顽闹的性儿，我叫你来，你嘴上应着，心里未必肯，常常府里寻不着影，要是指着你这丫头，我这眼睛只怕要望穿。”
陆婉儿腻在陆老夫人身侧，乖巧地说了一句：“这是祖母疼孙儿。”
戴缨看在眼里，暗忖，陆婉儿当真好命，本是穷苦人家的孤女，后被陆家大爷收养，金银窝里娇养到大。
正说着，丫鬟们手执木托子，鱼贯而入，将菜摆放上桌。
石榴扶老夫人坐于上首，其他人依序入座。
这一桌子菜馔如何精琢细脍、如何丰盛自不必说。
高汤灵菇片、蟹粉豆腐、香煎小羊排、虫草花炖鸽蛋、雕蒸鲥鱼……以及各类时蔬和细粥。
陆婉儿和陆溪儿每日见惯了这些，戴缨也还好，自家的衣食住行亦是豪奢，唯独谢珍看呆了眼，尽管她已努力克制。
陆老夫人身侧有石榴布菜，戴缨等人身边也有各自的丫鬟布让。
饭间无人言语，安静得只有光影晃动和碗碟磕碰的轻响。
饭毕，陆婉儿携着谢珍退去，陆溪儿坐了会儿也退下了，只有戴缨陪坐在陆老夫人身侧，讲些趣事。
这些趣事有些是从平谷家中的下人们那里听来的，有些是她现编的，她脑子活泛，不管老夫人说什么，总能应上。
“那苏家世代绣工，其中一幅锦绣河山的绣画乃是祖传，选作贡品，谁知苏家有一恶奴，平日偷奸耍滑惯了的，被主人家罚了月银，记恨在心，趁着无人之时将绣画戳了个大洞。”
戴缨一面说着，一面将温下来的茶递到陆老夫人手里。
老夫人认真听着，问道：“哟！
这可坏事，那等奴才不该留着，早早拖出去卖了。”
戴缨点头道：“谁说不是。”
“后来呢？”
老夫人又道，“贡品损坏乃杀头大罪。”
此时屋中的丫头们也围了过来，好奇故事会如何发展。
戴缨正待开口，陆老夫人的陪房周嬷嬷走到跟前，笑说道：“老夫人，阿郎来了，在外候着呢。”
戴缨听罢，赶紧起身，不知要回避还是要怎样。
“无事，你坐下，他长你一辈，日后在府里难免会碰到，现在见个礼也好。”
陆老夫人说道。
戴缨想了想也是，待谢容娶了顾婉儿，陆铭章便是谢容的岳父，论起来也是她的长辈，于是重新坐下。
丫鬟将门帘揭起，陆铭章走了进来。
只见其一身大袖紫色公服，袍摆及足，腰系白玉，悬着鱼袋。
陆铭章走上前向陆老夫人行礼：“儿子来看看母亲。”
“你公务繁忙，回来连衣也未更便来看我，难为你的孝心，坐下罢。”
content_en:
Shiliu brought Dai Ying to the upper room, where a lamp was already lit.
Mrs. Lu was sitting crookedly on the Arhat couch, with Lu Wan'er, Lu Xi'er, Xie Zhen and other juniors gathered around her, chatting and joking.
Mrs. Lu saw Dai Ying and waved her forward.
"Have all the businesses been arranged?"
"If you go back to the old lady, everything has been arranged."
Madam Lu, "Yes"
He shouted: "You can stay here in peace. If the servants in the mansion don't obey orders, speak up and don't stay silent."
That day at Qingshan Temple, the girl spoke sincerely, saying that she was a merchant and was afraid of hindering the future of Mr. Xie's family. She also said that she was willing to dissolve the engagement.
She didn't believe it. In Mrs. Lu's heart, the Xie family must have wanted to marry her, so in order to marry that girl Wan'er, Dai Ying had to cancel the engagement on her own.
In other words, their family ruined a good marriage for her, which made Mrs. Lu feel pity.
Lu Waner grew up next to her and was from her own family, so she had no choice but to aggrieve Dai Ying.
"Mrs. Lao is worried that Yingniang is not the one who keeps quiet. She is afraid that in the future the old lady will think that Yingniang talks too secretly."
Dai Yingqu said.
Mrs. Lu laughed happily and said, "That's great. I feel like the room is too quiet, so you often come over to talk to me."
There is nothing wrong with Dai Ying. This is the person she will rely on in the future. As long as she doesn't find it annoying, she would like to be in front of her all day long.
Just as he was talking, Lu Waner came closer and leaned on the other side of the old lady: "Grandma, why don't you let Waner come here more often? Sister Dai has only been here for a day, but your mind is already biased."
Mrs. Lu hit her angrily and said, "You are such a naughty person. When I ask you to come, you may say yes, but you may not agree in your heart. You are often nowhere to be found in the house. If I point at you, a girl, I'm afraid my eyes will see through her."
Lu Wan'er sat beside Mrs. Lu and said obediently, "This is how grandma loves her grandson."
Dai Ying saw this and thought to herself, Lu Wan'er was really lucky. She was originally an orphan from a poor family, but was later adopted by the Lu family, and she was raised in a nest of gold and silver.
Just as he was talking, the maids filed in holding wooden trays and placed the dishes on the table.
Pomegranate helped the old lady sit at the top, and the others took their seats in sequence.
It goes without saying how meticulously crafted and rich the dishes on this table are.
Mushroom slices in broth, crabmeal tofu, pan-fried lamb chops, braised pigeon eggs with cordyceps flowers, steamed anchovies... as well as various seasonal vegetables and thin porridge.
Lu Wan'er and Lu Xi'er were used to seeing this every day. Dai Ying was fine, and her family's food, clothing, housing and transportation were luxurious. Xie Zhen was the only one who was dumbfounded, even though she tried hard to restrain herself.
Mrs. Lu had pomegranate cloth beside her, and Dai Ying and others also had their own maid Bu Rang beside them.
No one spoke during the meal, it was so quiet that there was only the shaking of light and shadow and the gentle clatter of dishes.
After the meal, Lu Waner and Xie Zhen retreated. Lu Xier sat for a while and then retreated. Only Dai Ying sat beside Mrs. Lu and told some interesting stories.
Some of these anecdotes were heard from the servants in Pinggu's house, and some were made up by her. She had a quick mind and could always respond to whatever the old lady said.
"The Su family has been embroidery workers for generations, and one of the embroidery paintings of beautiful rivers and mountains was passed down from ancestors and was selected as a tribute. Who knew that the Su family had an evil slave who was used to cheating and cheating. He was fined a month's silver by his master. He held a grudge and poked a big hole in the embroidery painting when no one was around."
As Dai Ying spoke, she handed the warmed tea to Mrs. Lu's hand.
The old lady listened carefully and asked: "Yo!
This is a bad thing. Those slaves should not be kept, but dragged out and sold early. "
Dai Ying nodded and said, "Who says it's not?"
"What happened next?"
The old lady added, "Damaging the tribute is a serious crime of beheading."
At this time, the girls in the house also gathered around, curious about how the story would develop.
Just as Dai Ying was about to speak, Mrs. Lu's roommate, Mrs. Zhou, walked up to her and said with a smile: "Old madam, Alang is here and waiting outside."
After hearing this, Dai Ying quickly stood up, not knowing whether to avoid or how to avoid it.
"Nothing, just sit down. He is a generation older than you, so you will inevitably run into him in the house in the future. It's a good idea to greet him now."
Mrs. Lu said.
Dai Ying thought about it for a while. After Xie Rong married Gu Waner, Lu Mingzhang would be Xie Rong's father-in-law and her elder in terms of it, so he sat down again.
The maid lifted the door curtain and Lu Mingzhang walked in.
I saw him wearing a purple official uniform with large sleeves, the hem of the robe reached to his feet, a white jade tie around his waist, and a fish bag hanging on it.
Lu Mingzhang stepped forward and saluted Mrs. Lu: "Son, come to see your mother."
"You are so busy with official duties that you didn't even change your clothes when you came back to see me. It's difficult for you to sit down because of your filial piety."
title_en: Chapter 13: If he is older than you, you can call him uncle Chapter 14: It turns out that there has been a secret conspiracy for a long time
